text: Planning a trip is exciting but needs time. First, you choose a place, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious food. However, language barriers can be difficult. You may not understand people, so you use gestures or a translation app. These moments can be funny. Despite the challenges, travel creates wonderful memories. You remember the kind strangers, the beautiful views, and the lessons you learned. Every journey changes you a little. That is why travel is one of the best experiences in life.
